preconditions.description: The number of rows in the table is at least 1 and at most 100.
The number of columns in the table is at least 1 and at most 100.

postconditions.expression: output is a string of length n, where each character is an uppercase Latin letter
postconditions.description: The output is a string representing the lexicographically minimum coloring of the table.

postconditions.expression: each cell is painted some color
postconditions.description: All cells in the table are painted with some color.

postconditions.expression: each connected region forms a square
postconditions.description: The painted cells form a tiling of the table with squares.
The coloring is the lexicographically smallest possible given the constraints.
